case.title: Which submitted task was interrupted by Reactor scheduler shutdown?
case.title_zh: Reactor 调度器关闭时，被中断的任务是谁提交的？

findings.observation: One bounded check of Reactor 3.8.8 confirms that forceful bounded-elastic dispose interrupts a running SchedulerTask. The native InterruptedException stack identifies the blocking operation but omits the earlier submitOrderSynchronization entry.
findings.interpretation: Standard JDI observes the actual SchedulerTask constructor receiver and the receiver on the interrupted worker stack. Both have object ID 431. A separate read of the application returnedTask field confirms the same object. CoroPerf joins the saved creation and interruption events and recovers the historical submission entry.
findings.limits: This is a one-task component adaptation: Thread.sleep replaces the reported blocking HTTP wait. Forceful interruption agrees with dispose semantics; the case demonstrates creator attribution, not an incorrect API contract. Only one workload ran. The collector exits 1 during child shutdown after saving the evidence, so native process exit status is unverified. Capture ends at interruption; the missing terminal event does not imply a live or leaked task. No graceful variant, fix, alternate version, production traffic or overhead measurement ran.

case.symptom_zh: Reactor 3.8.8 的一次有界检查确认：强制关闭 bounded-elastic 调度器会中断正在运行的 SchedulerTask。原生 InterruptedException 栈能定位阻塞操作，但没有之前已返回的 submitOrderSynchronization 提交入口。
case.reasoning_zh: 标准 JDI 记录真实 SchedulerTask 的构造接收对象和中断工作线程栈中的接收对象，两者的对象 ID 都是 431。另行读取应用 returnedTask 字段，确认它也是同一对象。CoroPerf 将保存的创建和中断事件接起来，恢复历史提交入口。
case.limits_zh: 这是单任务组件改编：用 Thread.sleep 代替报告中的阻塞 HTTP 等待。中断符合 dispose 的强制关闭语义，本案例验证创建入口归因，不声称 API 契约错误。工作负载只执行一次。采集器保存证据后在子进程退出收尾中以 1 退出，原生进程退出码未验证。采集止于中断，没有终止事件不代表任务仍存活或泄漏。未运行优雅关闭变体、修复、多版本、生产流量或开销测试。

verification.scope: One real bounded-elastic SchedulerTask interrupted by dispose; a bounded Thread.sleep replaces the reported blocking HTTP wait.
limitations: Interruption is consistent with forceful dispose; this is a debugging case, not proof of an incorrect API contract.
Cached Reactor 3.8.8 and JDK 21 replace the original 2022 environment.
Collector exit 1 arose while checking child process liveness during shutdown. Constructor/exception/identity evidence and native output were saved; native process exit code is unverified.
No production traffic, hundreds of HTTP calls, graceful variant, fix, alternate version or replay was executed.
One task proves this creator join; concurrent-submitter discrimination and production overhead were not measured.

source_metadata.identity_evidence: Actual constructor receiver and exception-frame receiver, independently matched to the application returnedTask reference by JDI uniqueID.
source_metadata.clock: Ordered saved events; no durations inferred.
source_metadata.sample_scope: Two JDI observations during one interruption unwind, not two workload runs.
